''The Mantis outcasts sometimes make the mistake of taking the Zoltan for easy game. A scout moves in to attack while a boarding party beams aboard from a nearby transport!''
*<span style="color:red">2-3 mantis boarders</span> beam aboard your ship and you fight a [[Mantis Ships|Mantis Ship]] ([[Rewards#Default_rewards|default rewards]]). <ref name="Enemy ship (MANTIS_FIGHT)">{{SurrenderEscape(alt)|no|MANTIS_FIGHT|events_ships.xml}}</ref>

==Notes==
This event is called "ZOLTAN_BOARDERS_MANTIS" in the datafiles.
